headline: 6 law enforcers injured as gunfire targets Sajek tourist convoy
summary: Over 2,300 tourists were evacuated from the hill tracts after a gunfight between the Army and an armed group broke out amid a road blockade.
details: Six law enforcement personnel were injured after gunfire targeted a tourist convoy in Sajek Valley. The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) stated that the UPDF opened fire on tourists and security forces.
The violence erupted amid a road blockade by protesters, which had left nearly 2,000 tourists stranded on their way back to Khagrachari.
Over 2,300 tourists were eventually evacuated from the area following the clashes and reported gunfights.
Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer has called for immediate action regarding the incident, stating that no one has the right to play with the lives of ordinary citizens.
caption:

headline: Man beaten to death over child theft suspicion at Dhaka hospital
summary: A 41-year-old man was killed by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital after being suspected of child abduction.
details: A 41-year-old man named Alam Sheikh was beaten to death by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital in Dhaka on Wednesday night.
The incident occurred around 11 PM near the hospital's pediatric ward, where Sheikh was seen wandering. When questioned by relatives of patients, he was unable to provide a satisfactory answer.
A group of people subsequently dragged him down from the hospital building and beat him severely, resulting in his death at the scene.
Police recovered the body after receiving a call via the National Emergency Service 999. His identity was confirmed through fingerprint analysis.
The victim, a resident of Rupnagar, Dhaka, is claimed by his family to have been mentally unstable.
Authorities have detained one person in connection with the incident.
caption:
A man was beaten to death by a mob at a Dhaka hospital after being suspected of child theft.

A 41-year-old man named Alam Sheikh was beaten to death by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital in Dhaka on Wednesday night.

The incident occurred around 11 PM near the hospital's pediatric ward, where Sheikh was seen wandering. When questioned by relatives of patients, he was unable to provide a satisfactory answer.

A group of people subsequently dragged him down from the hospital building and beat him severely, resulting in his death at the scene.

Police recovered the body after receiving a call via the National Emergency Service 999. His identity was confirmed through fingerprint analysis.

The victim, a resident of Rupnagar, Dhaka, is claimed by his family to have been mentally unstable.

Authorities have detained one person in connection with the incident.
